connections.postConnectionsByIdPreview.description: A dry run of the next sync over the last 30 days of records, at most 200: what it would create, update, leave unchanged, skip or reject. New records wait (`counts.waiting`) while the template has no approved release (`releaseBlocked`). It reads the source and the connection's passes and writes nothing: no cursor moves and no run is recorded. `columns` lists the source's fields with up to three sample cells and, for a field with few distinct values, those values and their counts. Needs connections:read and passes:read.
